posts.title: Why Multi Window Multi Burn Rate SLO Alerting Sucks!
posts.description: Service Level Objectives (SLOs) are great! Alerts based on SLOs are great! posts.title: Should I learn C by writing a C compiler in C? (Part 3)
posts.description: The Pareto Principle states that 80% of results come from 20% of the effort. The mistake is then to look at your impressive results (from part 2) and conclude that you are 80% done. The last 20% take the remaining 80% of your effort. You're not even halfway to the halfway point.
